name: Interdisciplinary Biomedical Graduate Program (IBGP)

sources.label: School of Medicine PhD program directory

summary: An interdisciplinary PhD entry program with first-year laboratory rotations, followed by specialization in pathology or pharmacology.

english.toefl: 5 (tests after January 21, 2026); 100 (tests on or before January 21, 2026)
english.note: English test exemptions apply for a US degree or other approved English-instructed institutions; confirm eligibility with the program.

documents: Academic records/transcripts from all post-secondary institutions; certified English translations if applicable
requirements.note: School of Medicine states each program requires a minimum of 2–3 letters; confirm the IBGP count.

funding.note: All full-time graduate students receive a stipend, full tuition remission, and individual health insurance. The published 2026–2027 stipend is not copied as a Fall 2027 stipend.
